environment: Ubuntu 24.04 shared virtual runner; installed two-director IPVS/BIRD pair with nftables filters; 200 ms socket timeout in the synthetic forwarding check
limit: One shared virtual-runner result. The shorter timeout applies only to the synthetic installed check, not an automatic production setting. Zero route actions for one minute does not establish a false-failover rate. The 1000-mps steady-state trial begins after failover and recovery. Filter counter differences are not NIC ingress; cgroups exclude kernel dataplane CPU. No physical capacity or production SLO.
